split_strategy: Manual. Hard cases all in train: N1 (defer to find-marketing-agency for broader marketing scope), N2 (defer to find-web-developer for the build phase), N4 (consumer-personal wedding design — canonical out-of-scope life event), and indirect-intent positive P7. Validation tests generalization across remaining sub-disciplines and out-of-scope shapes.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.

queries.query: find me a UX/UI design agency for our SaaS product
we need a packaging design firm for a CPG launch
looking for a product design consultancy with hardware experience
we need someone to design the visual identity and packaging for our new line of beverages
queries.notes: HARD: indirect — describes work, no 'agency'/'firm'/'studio'. Tests describing-design-deliverable triggering.

queries.query: compare three UX/UI agencies with at least 4-star ratings and Fortune 500 clients
we need a creative agency for a brand system overhaul — logo, typography, color, voice
queries.notes: Full brand-system engagement; tests boundary with marketing-agency since 'creative agency' is shared terminology.

queries.query: shortlist three brand-identity studios in NY for our rebrand
build a longlist of 25 US design studios specializing in healthcare-tech UX
we shortlisted 10 design studio domains — pull contact info and confirm which specialize in motion design
queries.notes: BYO list (enrichment) using the proven 'specialize in' phrasing.

queries.query: find graphic design firms experienced with annual reports and investor decks
find me a marketing agency to handle our brand and demand-gen
queries.notes: HARD: broader marketing scope — defer to find-marketing-agency.

queries.query: we need a web developer to build the new site after the design is done
queries.notes: HARD: build phase — defer to find-web-developer. The 'after the design is done' framing should distinguish this from a design ask.

queries.query: I want to hire an in-house design lead for our team
I need a designer to make wedding invitations for our wedding next month
queries.notes: HARD: consumer-personal life event — canonical out-of-scope. Catalog is B2B-only.
